soldier: Head of the soldier pale yellow, nasus pale brown, antennae and legs pale yellow. Surface of the head covered with sparse fine hairs, the dorsum of the abdomen with more numerous short hairs. Head lute-shaped, narrow in front and broad behind, the sides rounded, slightly bulging near the occiput, the posterior margin arcuately rounded and slightly flat at its centre. Nasus slender, tubular, straight in lateral view. Mandibles with a pointed spine, the spine either long or short and small; in some individuals a spine on one side and a blunt projection without a distinct spine on the other. Antennae with 11 to 12 segments, in all of which segment 3 is longer than segment 2 and segment 2 longer than segment 4, segment 4 short and small. Neither the anterior nor the posterior margin of the pronotum with a distinct incision.
worker: Worker: apical tooth of the left mandible almost equal in size to the first marginal tooth, the cutting edges between the marginal teeth straight; apical tooth of the right mandible slightly smaller than or almost equal to the first marginal tooth, the second marginal tooth situated rather close to the first.
